steps.content: In the VIP seat of the high-altitude shuttle, you watch as the buildings below shrink as a ghostly pattern in the sky slowly grows before your eyes.
Whoom!

The shuttle jolts hard. Blinding color floods the cabin, and in an instant, the blue sky and clouds vanish, replaced by a dark crimson void. It's as if you and the aircraft have tumbled straight into the Black Ring.

But a second look tells you the Black Ring's glowing bands still lie motionless on the horizon. It's the wreckage outside—broken machinery, suspended and rushing past at savage speed—that tells you you're almost there.
[Presentation Room]

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: As you can see, BR-003 is currently the only Black Ring that humans can reliably control. It offers us an exceptionally valuable environment for experiments.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The work conducted here includes: dimensional eigenvalue calculation, real-time Mania fluctuation monitoring and early warning, ring structure maintenance and reinforcement, dimensional concealment technology, and so forth.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: At present, the primary focus remains the investigation of fluctuation data within Mania dimensions. Sarah oversees technical verification, Barrie specializes in signal modeling, while Enya coordinates data analysis.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: As for the most fundamental layer—the theoretical work on Mania dimensions, that is, would fall within Dr. Lemma's domain.
Schorl walks you through the Observation Hub's operations. You listen, then turn toward the scientists at the right moment.

options: Is weaponizing Black Ring part of your research as well?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: The previous team completed the basic framework back in N.F. 108. Our involvement is mainly in technical testing and follow-on application development. The primary project is research into Mania dimensional superposition.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: As for the specifics of the Ring Weapons, for security reasons, all related content has been transferred to higher-level EDGE authorities for centralized oversight. The Ring Research Institute and the Observation Hub are limited to supporting roles.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It wasn't exposed until last year's war. How did you keep it hidden before that? Was it your dimensional concealment technology?
They make no attempt to deny it.

options: And what exactly is the underlying principle behind this technology?

steps.content: Your eyes drift toward Lemma. Her head remains lowered throughout, and you cannot tell if she is purposefully feigning obliviousness or simply lost in thought.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let me guess. This is also something I'm not allowed to know?

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: We're partners, Chief. There's nothing to hide between us. It's simply that the theory is rather complex. Lemma is thinking over how to best present it.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: It might be a bit much to ask of a proud genius. Allow me.
She approaches you with a warm greeting and places herself right at your side, leaving Lemma with no space at all.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: As we understand it, Mania originates from the invasion of our material dimension by an unknown psychic dimension. The laws governing each side are fundamentally incompatible. Force them together, and the rules collapse, creating twisted, unpredictable chaos. That is what we call a catastrophe.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: But <color=#fb9259>dimensions</color> aren't limited to two extremes. Hidden within that seemingly chaotic fusion zone between the material and psychic dimensions, there exist multiple <color=#fb9259>sub-dimensions</color>. They don't follow a simple linear sequence. Instead, each is relatively independent, relatively stable, distinct yet layered, entangled in fluctuating multi-state configurations. And it's that very entanglement that creates the semblance of chaos.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Think of it like separate slabs of stone that have been stacked atop one another, forming a stratified composite. A Black Ring is the dimensional fusion boundary we can currently observe. It can also be understood as the most prominent of these sub-dimensions. Or rather, a superposition state of multiple sub-dimensions, all overlapping.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Building on this theory, we monitor Mania fluctuation data along the Black Ring's perimeter and have fitted six possible mathematical structures. One model's foundation was laid by Summer. Lemma's team carried it further and has since obtained several eigenvalues.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Oh, you guys actually solved it? Not bad, not bad at all.
Isomer offers her a gentle smile, then takes your arm and guides you to the other side. She summons a floating digital screen and places it before you.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Under finite boundary conditions, we can simulate Mania fusion through equations, measure and estimate the relevant parameters, and solve for several eigenvalues. Mathematically, each eigenvalue corresponds to a discrete sub-dimension within the current Mania field.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: As long as the boundary conditions hold, the eigenspace can remain relatively independent and stable. We transfer BR-003 into the safest one among them, and just like that, it'll vanish from <color=#fb9259>this side of reality</color>.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Our current dimensional computation work and the fissure technology derived from it both rely heavily on BR-003's Mania field. Its unique dimensional signature provides the stable boundary conditions that keep our experimental environment and calculations consistent.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Once we've fully mastered this technology, we'll be able to apply it across far broader scenarios. I have no doubt it will prove valuable in supporting your field operations as well.
Lemma rolls her eyes.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Well then, Lemma, why don't you give Chief a proper tour? You are the project lead, after all.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: This way.
